title: A Piece of Home
description: Kai quietly asks you to find a keepsake from the world he remembers.
completion_text: Seeing the Choso plush reminds Kai of the things that mattered to him back home. You keep the plush.

stages.title: A Piece of Home
stages.lead: Find the Choso plush. Hold it in your main hand and show Kai through his personal quest dialogue.
notes: Personal quest offered through the corresponding character's friendship dialogue.
Return to that character after completing the listed objectives.

objectives.description: Show Kai the Choso plush; it is not consumed.
